title: kate-ui: open the files that macOS sends
summary: When Finder, the Dock, or open -a hands the running app file URLs, the window opens each file in a tab. paths_from_urls keeps file URLs, decodes percent escapes, and drops other schemes. The bundle's document types make the app an editor for text files.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
/// Paths of the `file://` URLs, percent-decoded. Other URLs are dropped.
fn paths_from_urls(urls: &[String]) -> Vec<std::path::PathBuf>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Register the GPUI open-URLs handler in launch; for each path from paths_from_urls send FileRequest::OpenPath to the window, creating the window first when none is open. The test paths_from_urls_decodes_file_urls asserts [file:///tmp/a%20b.rs, https://x] gives [/tmp/a b.rs]. The owner double-clicks a text file in Finder with the bundle installed. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::paths_from_urls_decodes_file_urls
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because paths_from_urls does not exist. After the change a file URL becomes a decoded path and another scheme is dropped.
